en: Black-and-white landscape view taken from within a forest, looking down onto a small village in a valley surrounded by densely wooded hills. The foreground shows tall dark tree trunks framing the image, while in the middle distance there are scattered houses, a church-like building with a steeple, open meadows, and tree-lined roads. At the bottom left, text is printed identifying the location as 'Wildenthal i. Erzgeb.'.
